_comment: Demo rules for agent-1 (sandbox and testnet), the same numbers as demo_rules() in tests/common/mod.rs. setup fills expires_at_ns with block time + 7 days and drops this comment. Units: max_order_notional and daily_cap are 1e-6 quote units (per-order cap 500, daily cap 1200, one daily counter shared by both targets); max_per_order is raw token units (USDC has 6 decimals, so 5 USDC per transfer). The one receiver is the owner test address of the EVM vectors.
